description: This file defines a Java interface 'PersistenceConfig' which specifies configuration settings for health check persistence including methods to check if persistence health check is enabled, get timeout durations, and retrieve metrics reporter configuration. It also includes an enumeration 'PersistenceConfigValue' for default configuration values.

classes.name: PersistenceConfig
classes.description: Interface for persistence health check configuration settings.

classes.name: PersistenceConfig.PersistenceConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and default values for PersistenceConfig.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Determines whether the persistence health check should be enabled.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for the persistence health check.

methods.name: getMetricsReporterConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration settings of the metrics reporter.
